# WAF Classic

Store global WAF Classic control-plane records only, with no request filtering.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `waf` |
| Signing name | `waf` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2015-08-24` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 65 of 77 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#waf-classic) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only, no request filtering, request evaluation, enforcement, metrics, sampled requests or rate counters; regex strings are stored verbatim without executing or validating against an AWS regex engine.
- WAF Regional, ALB/API Gateway associations, rule groups, managed rule subscriptions and permission policies are unsupported.
- No CloudFront association integration or CloudFormation resource handlers; resource changes require unused change tokens, while tag and logging APIs follow their token-free AWS request shapes.
- List cursors use resource IDs and tags use keys; Limit is 1-100. Classic IPv4 ranges support /8 and /16-/32, IPv6 /24,/32,/48,/56,/64,/128; names are immutable.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
